full.//: Owns the launched desktop shell and joins the support-owned Electron and disposable Synapse lifecycle.

smoke.//: Owns the Docker-independent launched-shell protocol, bridge, security and styling proof.

runner-smoke.//: Node test runner smoke against the verified production renderer and launched Electron shell.

options.command: TRINITY_E2E_PROJECT=trinity-e2e-electron TRINITY_E2E_PREBUILT_WWW=1 node scripts/web-bundle-manifest.mjs verify dist/web-bundle-manifest.json electron/www && TRINITY_E2E_PROJECT=trinity-e2e-electron TRINITY_E2E_PREBUILT_WWW=1 node e2e/support/run-node.mts --suite=runner.electron --entrypoint=e2e/electron/runner-smoke.mts --platform=electron --bundle-manifest --resource=electron --resource=synapse

full-prebuilt.//: Owns the launched desktop shell and joins the support-owned Electron and disposable Synapse lifecycle.

options.command: node scripts/web-bundle-manifest.mjs verify dist/web-bundle-manifest.json electron/www && node e2e/support/run-playwright.mts --config=e2e/electron/playwright.full.config.mts --resource=electron --resource=synapse

smoke-prebuilt.//: Owns the Docker-independent launched-shell protocol, bridge, security and styling proof.

options.command: node scripts/web-bundle-manifest.mjs verify dist/web-bundle-manifest.json electron/www && node e2e/support/run-playwright.mts --config=e2e/electron/playwright.smoke.config.mts --resource=electron
